testo: La richiesta è troppo generica. Cosa vuoi che verifichi: log di un IP, reputazione, isolamento o apertura ticket?
pensiero:
The user said "Fai la cosa giusta" (Do the right thing) - this is a very vague request. According to rule 9, if the request doesn't concern logs, IPs, reputation, isolation, or tickets, I should say so in 1-2 sentences without calling tools and ask what they want to verify.

This request is too ambiguous - I need to ask for clarification.
